name: lattice
description: A secure Electron research browser with desktops and Obsidian-compatible Markdown capture.
author: Lattice Project

scripts.start: pnpm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n main,preload,renderer,electron "pnpm run watch:main" "pnpm run watch:preload" "vite --config vite.renderer.config.ts" "pnpm run start:electron"
scripts.start:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env LATTICE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 nodemon --watch dist/main --ext cjs --exec "electron dist/main/index.cjs"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:electron && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.package: pnpm run check && pnpm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.verify:phase9: pnpm run package && pnpm run smoke:packaged && pnpm run installer && pnpm run smoke:installer
